coding.note: C1 is restricted to contributions and priority claims in the abstract/introduction; later technical recipe decisions are not automatically treated as novelty claims. Repeated claims are consolidated. Data disclosure is conservatively PARTIAL: Table 15 gives category fractions and named sources, but not the within-category source proportions needed to reconstruct the mixture. Comparator names summarize the principal results tables by model family (maximum 15). Third-party YES refers to the explicitly reported BigScience evaluation of comparator GPT-3, not an independent evaluation of Falcon. VAR refers to small-scale reference/ablation experiments, not repeated training of the released large models. No clear renaming of an existing technique is established; monolayer names a custom implementation rather than unambiguously renaming selective recomputation.
